'''Mykapo''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> located in the [[Mykapo system]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Timelines" /> It was the [[homeworld]] of [[Phoenix Cell]]'s [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]],<ref name="Databank" /> his nephew [[Mart Mattin]],<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> the latter's [[Sato|father]], and [[Yosh Calfor]], a [[private]] who served in the [[Alliance Military]].<ref name="TUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>

In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "[[Iron Squadron]]" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," the events of the episode must also take place in 2 BBY.</ref> Mykapo was the location of a [[Realspace|space]] [[Skirmish over Mykapo|battle]] between the [[Iron Squadron]], Phoenix [[Squadron]] and the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> Some [[time]] later the [[Krawg pirates]] raided [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] from Mykapo.<ref name="Star Wars 34">[[Star Wars (2015) 34|''Star Wars'' (2015) 34]]</ref>

At some point Mykapo [[Mykapo system planetary defense forces|maintained its own military]] to patrol the system. One of its leaders, [[Idrosen Gawat]], later joined [[Resistance High Command]].<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mykapo was named after [[Mickey Capoferri]], an executive producer of ''[[Rebels Recon]]'' and ''[[The Star Wars Show]]''.<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/iron-squadron-trivia-gallery|text="Iron Squadron" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>
